question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team,
        SUM(home_wins) + SUM(away_wins) as total_wins
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            league,
            home_team as team,
            CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as home_wins,
            0 as away_wins
        FROM match_view
        WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            league,
            away_team as team,
            0 as home_wins,
            CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as away_wins
        FROM match_view
        WHERE home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    ) wins
    GROUP BY league, team
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY total_wins) as rn
    FROM team_wins
)
SELECT league, team, total_wins
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league
